prompt: Flat 2D fantasy video game boss art: the upper body of one colossal cosmic titan seen from the front, a half-length bust cut off at the chest by the bottom edge of the image, so vast that it fills the whole width. In place of a head, a perfect pitch-black eclipse disc, dark and solid, ringed by a thin white-hot rim and a blazing corona of orange, gold and white flame streamers fanning across the whole sky behind it. Its two shoulders are vast jagged mountain ranges of black stone with gold seams and lit ridgelines, curving down at the far left and right edges like the rim of a planet. Its chest is a crust of black stone plates with glowing orange ember cracks and gold veins, with thin rose and violet mist across the shoulders. A tall vertical fissure splits the middle of the chest, white-hot in the centre and gold at the edges. Its right forearm of layered black-gold rock plates reaches down at the lower right and its colossal stone hand with four clawed fingers and a thumb hooks over the lower edge. Four separate round glowing moons float in front of the shoulders and chest: one frost cyan, one ember orange, one deep teal, one storm white. Crisp hard edges, flat cel shading with few tones, bold readable shapes, light from the upper left.
